findings.title: Missing handoff from completed pre-Attempt readiness to separately authorized execution
findings.evidence: Window.run sets _used and returns readiness; DisposableArmExecution.run unconditionally calls window.run again. A completed window cannot be consumed. No entrypoint accepts the returned readiness. Integration fixture replaces window.run, hiding the one-shot interaction.
findings.reproduction: Object-only diagnostic: window=object.__new__(PreAttemptFrozenRuntimeWindow); window._used=True; execution=object.__new__(DisposableArmExecution); execution._used=False; execution.window=window; execution.run() => RuntimeWindowError PRE_ATTEMPT_INFRA_FAILURE / STOP before backend or ledger access. This reproduces completed-window guard, not a live readiness run.
findings.rule: Current owner scope explicitly requires creation/pre-Attempt STOP followed by separate execution authorization; existing one-shot and frozen-runtime constraints must remain.
findings.required_fix: Add a narrowly bound handoff that consumes the already-established readiness and revalidates freeze/Pair/identities before any Attempt; preserve no-retry and one-shot checks. Do not reset _used or substitute a second qualification run as reuse of the original readiness.
